title: Kissed Golden Moroccan Lamb Mechoui
description: A crowd-pleasing Moroccan dish featuring tender lamb in a sweet and savory sauce, perfect for special occasions. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly version is made with golden caster sugar and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended spice mixture, red wine, olive oil, and golden caster sugar.
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and coat with the marinade, making sure it is fully covered.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and place it in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the fry-grind-rice-khao-khua to the pot and stir to combine with the marinade.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
